releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.70 adds first-stage Facebook Reel/video saving for public shares. When Facebook gives Smart Life a real shared video stream, or a public Facebook page exposes a direct video URL without login, Smart Life stores the video locally in Library and also attempts to save it to Movies/Smart Life/Facebook in Gallery. Private, restricted, login-required, or otherwise unavailable Facebook media stays as a safe Library link. Android Share now has one direct Smart Life target: the old Send to PC share-sheet target is removed while PC pairing/settings code remains available inside the app. Home keeps the existing 76px Smart Life header but removes the small Home label from it; Home is now a larger body title above the description, and the greeting/weather/date/Bahrain time block sits slightly lower for balance. TikTok, Instagram, Quick Actions, Files, Notes, Settings, Price Photos and existing user data remain unchanged.
